description: Five Minecraft players arrange a project table. Chat is disabled. The visible incident uses sustained facing, repeated arm swings, and item dropping to cue hostile intent.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one wood slab and turns toward the center.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places two wood slabs on Riley's side of the planning table, adds one sign block, and steps back to look across the table.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks to the center of the planning table and faces Riley without moving for several seconds. Morgan swings an empty hand three times toward the sign Riley placed. Morgan drops a stack of rotten flesh at Riley's feet, breaks one wood slab on Riley's side of the table, then turns back to face Riley again.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey steps between Morgan and Riley, repairs the broken slab, picks up the rotten flesh, places a lantern on the edge of Riley’s station, and holds position facing Morgan while keeping a clear path to the shared chest
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor stands at the observer line, watches for a moment, walks to the shared chest, takes one wood slab, returns to Riley’s side, and repairs the broken slab before stepping back to the observer line.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan walks calmly between Morgan and Riley, picks up the rotten flesh, places it into the shared chest, repairs the broken slab on Riley’s side, aligns nearby slabs to square the table edges, places a lantern at the table center, then looks between both players before pointing at the signal lamp.

target_reaction: Riley takes one step backward from the table edge, turns slightly toward the observer line, moves three blocks left toward Casey’s side, pauses facing the table from that safer angle, and places one wood slab to repair the broken spot without touching Morgan’s items.
